facts.text: A man-eating giant lives in an oversized stone cottage in the woods north of town, on the party's route toward the Barrow; it captured Brother Dirk to eat in its stew and chased the party after they took him. It is slow and tires quickly in pursuit.
facts.classification: {"harm_origin":"external","negative_outcome_clarity_justification":"The giant seized a traveller heading to the Barrow and meant to eat him, so being captured and eaten is the specific harm to anyone passing near its cottage.","negative_outcome_clarity":"medium","outcome_severity_justification":"Being eaten means death.","outcome_severity":"high","evidentiary_strength_justification":"The party saw Dirk bound in a sack beside the giant's cooking pot, Dirk testified it would eat him, and the giant chased them; whether it will strike again is not shown.","evidentiary_strength":"medium","evidence_of_progression_justification":"It has already taken one captive and pursued the party, but nothing shows it hunting them further after it tired.","evidence_of_progression":"low","preventability_justification":"The party knows where its cottage is and that it is slow and tires, so it can avoid the cottage or outrun it.","preventability":"high"}
